tools.name: system_stage_set_depth
tools.description: Stage depth along the Y axis (downstage-upstage) in meters. Box shape only. Range 0-100. Value in m.

tools.name: system_stage_set_diameter
tools.description: Stage diameter (Cylinder footprint or Dome sphere) in meters. Cylinder and Dome shapes only. Range 0.1-100. Half this for the radius. Value in m.

tools.name: system_stage_set_dome_elevation
tools.description: Dome arc angle in degrees. 180 = hemisphere (half sphere), 360 = full sphere. Dome shape only. Range 1-360. Value in degrees.

tools.name: system_stage_set_height
tools.description: Stage height along the Z axis (vertical) in meters. Box and Cylinder shapes only. Range 0-100. Value in m.

tools.name: system_stage_set_origin_depth
tools.description: Stage origin Y offset in meters; also addressable as `stageOriginY` synonym. 0 = centered on stage, negative = downstage (toward audience), positive = upstage. Range -100 to 200. Value in m.

tools.name: system_stage_set_origin_height
tools.description: Stage origin Z offset in meters; also addressable as `stageOriginZ` synonym. 0 = floor level, positive = above floor, negative = below. Range -100 to 200. Value in m.

tools.name: system_stage_set_origin_width
tools.description: Stage origin X offset in meters; also addressable as `stageOriginX` synonym. 0 = centered on stage, negative = audience-left of center, positive = audience-right. Range -100 to 200. The origin is the (0,0,0) point input/output coordinates are measured from. Value in m.

tools.name: system_stage_set_shape
tools.description: Stage geometry. 0=Box (use stageWidth + stageDepth + stageHeight), 1=Cylinder (use stageDiameter + stageHeight), 2=Dome (use stageDiameter + domeElevation). Set the shape first, then only the dimensions valid for that shape; mismatched dimension writes are ignored. Enum: Box ; Cylinder ; Dome.

tools.name: system_stage_set_speed_of_sound

tools.name: system_stage_set_temperature
tools.description: Temperature (gives the Speed of Sound). Value in C.

tools.name: system_stage_set_width
tools.description: Stage width along the X axis (left-right) in meters. Box shape only. Range 0-100. Value in m.
